primitives.verbatim_quote: 60 PRINCIPLES OF BEHAVIOR to micturate, the need for rest (after protracted exertion), the need for sleep (after protracted wakefulness), and the need for activity (after protracted inaction).
primitives.assumptions: Drive states are modeled as monotonically increasing functions of time since last satisfaction.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When D(t) > T, behavioral response is triggered.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Belief update on drive state via posterior probability P(D|E). GSE: State transition from D(t) to D(t+1) based on action potential magnitude.

primitives.name: Species Maintenance Drives
primitives.verbatim_quote: The drives concerned with the maintenance of the species are those which lead to sexual intercourse and the need represented by nest building and care of the young.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S(t)': 'species survival drive strength at time t (dimensionless)', 'R': 'reproductive readiness parameter (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Reproductive behaviors are encoded as high-order drive patterns with strong temporal coupling.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When S(t) > R, reproductive behavior is activated.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Bayesian inference on mating success likelihood. GSE: Transition to nesting/care substates.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of pair-bonding and parental care behaviors.

primitives.name: Adaptive Behavioral Core
primitives.verbatim_quote: The primary core or mode of the range of innate or reflex tendencies to action must naturally vary from one need to another if the behavior is to be adaptive.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'B_i(t)': 'behavioral mode i at time t (dimensionless)', 'A_i': 'adaptation coefficient for mode i (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Behavioral modes are orthogonal in their response space and vary according to environmental entropy.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When A_i < 0, behavioral mode i becomes non-adaptive.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Conformal prediction of optimal behavioral mode. GSE: State machine switching between B_i(t).
layer2.telemetry: Entropy reduction in behavioral outcome space.
